problem: Installed dev.50 exits before responding to Command-Shift-V when a file-path card is rendered.
cause: NSTextField hosted directly by NSViewRepresentable repeatedly invalidates width-dependent intrinsic constraints; local diagnostic counted 2865 updates on that label versus 2-4 on others.
fix: Use an NSView container with frame-owned label layout, pure text measurement capped at two lines, and idempotent attributed-text updates.
